_comment: Frame-master registry for print-assets:mockups. Copy to frames.json once the six masters exist under gitignored design/print-assets/frames_blanks/. Masters are OPAQUE blanks (baked background + shadow, any canvas ratio); window = the sheet rect as fractions of the master canvas — the sheet is composited OVER it, then centre-cropped to 7:10. Framed windows must match the FAP sheet ratio 0.70, mount windows the CFPM aperture ratio 0.667, within 2% (composeMockup fail-closes otherwise). All six masters exist as of 2026-07-20 (1254x1254): framed = black_wood/natural_wood/dark_wood blanks (window ratios 0.696-0.698, MEASURED; dark_wood_frame replaces the rejected 0.746 brown blank), mount = *_wood_mount blanks generated from them per the runbook recipe (mat #FCFBF8, aperture 85.7% x 90% centred, 3px bevel ring outside the aperture, soft top shadow). Mount windows are DECLARED inset from the drawn aperture (top 6px, sides/bottom 2px) so the bevel ring and top shadow stay visible around the pasted sheet — do not re-measure them back out to the bare aperture.
